name: MahaBharat International Trade Expo 2026 (Sambhajinagar)
why_it_matters: This expo offers significant opportunities for networking, B2B meetings, and exploring global business collaborations, particularly for MSMEs in Maharashtra. It's a platform to find domestic distributors, retailers, and FMCG companies.

name: MahaBharat International Trade Expo 2026 (Mumbai)
why_it_matters: A major trade expo in Mumbai, offering extensive networking with international brands, MSMEs, and high-impact B2B opportunities for both domestic and export markets.

name: NFPAT 2026 – 2nd Cycle (National Food Processing Aptitude Test)
why_it_matters: Provides access to 400+ job opportunities across 50+ leading food companies and complimentary food safety masterclasses. Relevant for IMM to recruit skilled talent and enhance food safety knowledge within the team.

name: "Vaaram Thorum Varthaga Aalosanai" (Weekly Virtual Export Advisory Platform)
why_it_matters: Offers expert guidance on agri and food products processing, technology, marketing, and export-related queries. Valuable for Supab Exports for market insights and for IMM for processing and technology updates.

name: INTERENEF – International Energy Forum
why_it_matters: The conference theme "Energy and food sovereignty in an era of deglobalization" is highly relevant for understanding global food supply chain resilience and strategic positioning for dehydrated food exports.
